name: Ristikontra
description: Ristikontra is a Finnish Sedma-group game for 4 in partnerships. Tricks won by the last card of same rank as led (no suit hierarchy). 6 cards each; stock. Point cards: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2 (120 total). 61+ points = 1 game point. First to 7 wins. May play top stock 'in the dark'.

history.origins: Ristikontra is a Finnish game for four players, popular in lumber camps, and is likely the original of the Sedma group. In that group, tricks are won by the last card of equal rank to the card led. These games are played only in a region from Lapland in the north to Hungary in the south; Ristikontra is the Finnish member of that Central European ace–ten family.
timeline: 20th century: Finnish Sedma-group variant documented; related to Central European Sedma, Hola, Zsírozás.

rules.objective: Take tricks containing point cards (A, 10, K, Q, J). Score at least 61 card points (more than half of 120) to win 1 game point; take all 120 to score 2 game points. First team to the target (usually 7) wins the match.
rules.gameplay: 1. Trick won by last card of same rank as led. 2. Draw from stock after each trick. 3. May play top stock 'in the dark'. 4. Cannot lead same rank four tricks in a row. 5. 60-60 = abeyance.

strategy.basic: Win point cards; coordinate with partner.
tips: Play in the dark when advantageous.
